# CI vision

Catch material contract, consumer and engine regressions cheaply on Linux. Native distribution evidence is deliberate, selected-platform work rather than a per-push matrix rebuild; deep workspace analysis stays local. Preserve package provenance when requested, without treating development builds as release or physical GPU certification. Later geometry and manufacturing checks enter automatic CI only when their signal justifies their cost.
